shortDescription: Manages MLAG interfaces on HUAWEI CloudEngine switches.

options.name: dfs_group_id
options.description: ID of a DFS group.The value is 1.

options.name: eth_trunk_id
options.description: Name of the local M-LAG interface. The value is ranging from 0 to 511.

options.name: interface
options.description: Name of the interface that enters the Error-Down state when the peer-link fails. The value is a string of 1 to 63 characters.

options.name: mlag_error_down
options.description: Configure the interface on the slave device to enter the Error-Down state.

options.name: mlag_id
options.description: ID of the M-LAG. The value is an integer that ranges from 1 to 2048.

options.name: mlag_priority_id
options.description: M-LAG global LACP system priority. The value is an integer ranging from 0 to 65535. The default value is 32768.

options.name: mlag_system_id
options.description: M-LAG global LACP system MAC address. The value is a string of 0 to 255 characters. The default value is the MAC address of the Ethernet port of MPU.

options.name: state
options.description: Specify desired state of the resource.
